title: [CQ-M07b1] executionReadiness: pin three edge rows QA mutants survived
description:
A test-only follow-up from CQ-M07b QA round 3 (qa-c5835a34, 2026-11-01). The landed evaluator (completion 3c30b30a) behaves correctly. But no row in executionReadiness.test.ts pins three of its guards, so a refactor could drop any of them with the suite still green.

QA proved each gap in a git-archive copy. The three rows below pass on the original module (117/117), and each matching mutant fails exactly its own row. The harness is /tmp/moe-qa-c5835a34-mut/pin.py.

Add these rows to packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/executionReadiness.test.ts and change no other file:
1. ALONE table: 'a valid key reached through a directory symlinked into the project'.
   - Setup: symlinkSync(dir(project, 'secret'), path.join(root, 'keys-link'), 'junction'), then runnerKeyPath = await keyFor(project, path.join(root, 'keys-link')).
   - Expect exactly ['authenticated-runner-evidence'].
   - Why: realpath(keyPath) in runnerKeyFiled is the only guard against an intermediate-directory symlink into the project. lstat and O_NOFOLLOW cover only the final component.
2. PROBES table: a rejection { killed: false, signal: 'SIGKILL', code: null } gives provider-probe-failed.
   - Why: an external kill is not execFile's timeout. This kills the mutant where timedOut keys on signal instead of killed.
3. ALONE table, POSIX only: a daemonInstallDir whose directory name contains a real newline character expects exactly ['protected-host-control-plane'].
   - Why: this kills the mutant where absolute() drops the CONTROL test.

Size: about 10 test lines. No runtime change.
definitionOfDone: A row where runnerKeyPath reaches a valid key through a directory symlinked into the project expects exactly ['authenticated-runner-evidence']. It fails when runnerKeyFiled compares the unresolved keyPath instead of realpath(keyPath).

A probe rejection { killed: false, signal: 'SIGKILL', code: null } expects exactly ['isolated-agent-and-qa-vms', 'isolated-check-vm', 'provider-probe-failed']. It fails when timedOut keys on signal instead of killed.
On POSIX, a daemonInstallDir whose name contains a control character expects exactly ['protected-host-control-plane']. It fails when absolute() drops the CONTROL test.

executionReadiness.ts and runnerChannel.ts are byte-unchanged. The CQ-M07b archive gate (npm ci, tsc --noEmit, then vitest over executionReadiness.test.ts and runnerChannel.test.ts) passes in a git-archive snapshot, never in the shared checkout.
taskRails: Test-only: edit only packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/executionReadiness.test.ts. Unit tests never spawn a real Multipass client.
